item.title: Inference Optimization: What Should You Choose?
item.description: A 2026 map of inference options: graph compilers and runtimes, LLM serving engines, mobile and edge runtimes, and PyTorch deployment paths, with a device coverage matrix.

item.title: The Shift in GPU Optimization: From Threads to Tiles
item.description: Rewriting models for TensorRT and ONNX Runtime is tiring. This post follows GPU programming as it moves from threads to tiles with Triton, CuTe, Pallas, and CUDA Tile.

item.title: Inference Optimization: How to Approach It
item.description: An overview of inference optimization techniques such as compute and memory bound analysis, precision, kernel fusion, and quantization, and how to choose among them.
